parameters: It's been far too long since I've ventured this far into the edges of the frozen abyss.\! Fort Rittenbach. A monument of our heritage, and to our survival... still it stands.

There, the Sayunaari seem to have fortified a central position within the fortress.\! I must wonder, why? Their reputation as such strident warriors, against these... petty bandits?\! No matter. Army of Embor, we shall rid Fort Rittenbach of these invaders and return Donar's glory to this place.
You...\| you must be the lord of these lands.\| Duke Jaromir?
Donar's mercy...\| Y-yes, and I am afraid you have me at a disadvantage, for I do not know your name.
Ragavi, General of the Sayunaari Defense Army of Dakur.\! We owe you our lives. But I am afraid all we may have done nothing but doom you alongside all of us.
Honored, General Ragavi of the Sayunaari. I'm afraid you owe us nothing, for surely this rabble was no threat to you...
No...\| here they come once again! Steel yourselves, Emborians!
